title: 第15章 晋级，召唤！第16章 菲奥娜，致命的华尔兹
content_zh:
第十五章 晋级，召唤！
其实两人早就有猜测，秦轩是从拥有‘英雄神典’后才渐渐恢复实力的，并且经脉也有愈合的趋势，可是如今，实力停滞不前不说，就连经脉的修复也停止了。
联想到‘英雄神典’如此渴望获得重宝离火钟，虽说避免不了其某种私心的嫌疑，但是也有可能关系到秦轩能不能突破。
只是，目前还无法断定。
秦飞远等人的目的已经很明确了，就是想要夺取重宝离火钟，对此，秦轩自然不会没头没脑的将离火钟送出去。
先不说这离火钟已经入了他口袋了，单是‘重宝’二字也不可能让他放弃，但以目前他的实力来说，打又打不过，逃也逃不了。
既然如此，与其便宜眼前这些人，还不如拼一把，将其给‘英雄神典’炼化，说不定还能有一定的作用，这样对自己也有点好处。
当然，这并不代表着秦轩对‘英雄神典’里的神秘灵魂率先低头。
“不行，我无法主动沟通它。”盖伦的声音显得有些无耐。
嘴角微微一翘，秦轩的眼里闪过一抹揶揄，看来，这家伙的脾气不小嘛。
也不理会在场所有人惊讶的表情，秦轩面色猛的一肃，口中冷喝道，“我知道你能听到我说话，我承认，你比我想象中的还要傲慢。”
“可是你别忘了，如果我今天死了，你又会是怎样的一个下场！”
“还有，我的忍耐是有限度的，别拿我的忍耐，当做你傲慢的资本。”
话音刚落，除了秦轩本人外，不论是实力强绝的秦飞远，还是在一旁虎视眈眈的秦五等人，先是一愣，紧接着脸色狂变，体内的玄气高速运转起来，一股恐怖的气浪在十人周身凝聚而成，顿时将四周的树木震得摇摇晃晃，尘土飞扬。
秦轩莫名的话，给众人的第一反应就是，周围有强者！而且还是自己等人惹不起的强者！
要知道，秦飞远和秦五皆是炼体九重，秦飞远更是达到了九重巅峰，距离气海境也不过是一步之遥，而能在周围隐匿那么久，还不被其发现的，这绝对是气海境强者才拥有的实力！
时间一分一秒过去，意料中气海境强者并没有出现。
又过去了几分钟，让人确定周围除了自己等人外并无他人后，秦飞远这才松了口气，缓缓的收回身上的气势，若真是有气海境强者跟在秦轩身边的话，不说抢夺重宝了，自己等人的生命，怕也是要交代在这里了。
秦五也是松了口气，别看他拥有炼体九重的实力，可是在面对气海境强者的时候，就算再多个十几二十个炼体九重的武者，也不够气海境强者热身的。
气海境，就是一个实力的绝对分水岭！

似是感觉自己被耍了，自傲如秦飞远脸色顿时变得无比难看，一阵红一阵青，声音阴森的说道，“秦轩，别耍花样，快点将重宝拿出来，本公子的耐心也是有限的！”
“呵呵……秦轩，不如我俩合作，只要你将重宝借我用三个月，我西府等人便保证你安然离开这里，如何？”秦五也不甘示弱，眼珠稍微一转，便笑着说道，“我以西府的名誉保证。”
仿若看白痴一样瞥了一眼秦五，秦飞远并没有说话，只是紧紧的盯着眼前黑衣少年，似乎一点都不担心少年会答应这个诱人的条件一般。
翻了翻白眼，秦轩的确不会答应这个‘诱人的条件’，秦五与秦飞远斗起来保不保得住自己性命还是个问题，再者，秦轩可不会傻到去认为‘借用三个月’后还能拿回来。
至于拿西府的名誉保证？
这就更可笑了，你秦五算老几？就算当初的秦江伟都不敢说出这样的话。
“看来秦江伟被自己斩杀后，这秦五还真是越来越把自己处在高位了。”
心中暗自叹了口气，秦轩丝毫不急，静静的等待着，等待着‘英雄神典’的决定，他已经暂时将自己放在被动的位置，也已经将话说得很明白了，虽然话中有些威胁的味道，而且还显得有些强硬。
但是他相信‘英雄神典’的灵魂懂得把握住这个机会。
一个暂时压住秦轩这个主人的机会！
是的，只是暂时，虽然秦轩不知道‘英雄神典’的灵魂是何方神圣，但是他绝对不会让其压在自己的头上！
绝对不会！
兀的，就在秦轩沉思时，停留在其丹田内‘英雄神典’轻微的一动，就仿佛一座巨大的机器动了一下齿轮一般，可是秦轩依旧清晰的感受到。
“主人，它让你解除对离火钟的认主。”
盖伦的声音适时的响起。
点了点头，‘英雄神典’已经做出了决定，秦轩也不再废话，心中一动，就在秦飞远众人的目光下，悄然解除与重宝离火钟的联系。
认主一解除，不等离火钟脱体而出，‘英雄神典’顿时分出万千红色丝线，将离火钟缠绕包裹住，红色丝线就如一团火红的火焰般，紧接着，第一页自动翻开，离火钟瞬间被扯吸进去。
痛，在离火钟被‘英雄神典’纳入后，无尽的痛苦顿时如潮水般涌了上来。
但如果来到秦轩的丹田处，不难发现，此时正有一团团烈焰正在其血液中熊熊燃烧着，烧着他的骨骼，烧着他的四肢百骸，五脏六腑！
这一刻，秦轩很想将体内的痛苦吼出来，但是他又不能在秦飞远等人面前表现出不适，否则到时候引来怀疑，那一切就前功尽弃了。

低着头，一张脸憋得通红无比，牙齿紧咬，秦轩只觉得这种痛就如有成千上万只蚂蚁在啃噬你的骨髓一般，又痒又痛。
终于，远处的秦飞远似乎没了耐心，在他看来，面对自己，黑衣少年根本就是在做垂死挣扎，无路可逃，甚至不用自己出手，自己手下都轻松将其制服，之所以自己会亲自跟过来，也是自己大哥安排，以防万一罢了。
炼体六重？只不过是一个笑话罢了，当日能击杀秦江伟，也不过是这小子走运而已。
是的，在秦飞远，甚至在全体秦家年轻一辈的眼里，秦轩能击败甚至斩杀秦江伟，不过是运气。
朝着旁边两名炼体七重的南府弟子使了一眼颜色，两人立马会意，嘴角升起一抹狞笑，体内的玄气喷薄而出，一股不弱的气势朝着那低头的黑衣少年席卷而去，紧接着，嗖的一声，两人同时朝少年飞奔而去，单手成爪，直逼少年的要害处。
时刻关注场中变化的秦五见到南府的人动手，脸色微微一变，点了点头，旁边两名炼体八重的西府弟子瞬间窜了出去，速度不知比那两名炼体七重的南府弟子快上多少，气势上也强上许多。
南府这边丝毫不示弱，又是一名炼体八重的弟子飞奔出去，不过他的目标却是指向那名西府同是炼体八重的弟子，看样子，他的任务是要将其拦下。
似是对一切无所觉一般，秦轩始终低着头，仿若放弃了挣扎的机会一般，看在秦飞远的眼里，又是一阵冷笑。
废物终究是废物。
轰轰轰。
这时，异变突起，一股强大的气息自黑衣少年的身上溢出，毫无征兆的，而他的玄气，也不断的往上攀升，再攀升……
风，肆虐而起，将周围一些小树连根拔起，浑厚的气息，使得在场所有人呼吸都为之一滞。
恐怖，压抑！
不等众人反应，空地上猛的出现一道刺眼的红光，就连天上的烈日也暗淡了少许，仿佛整个世界都变成了红色一般，随后，一股恐怖冰冷的剑意凭空降临，仿若君临天下般，令人畏惧胆寒。
刺眼的光芒还未退去，剑光乍起，代替了天上那轮烈日，耀眼夺目，犀利与无尽的杀意布满全场，仿佛这剑，只为杀而生。
剑芒来得快，去得也快，待得剑芒消散，秦飞远等人才睁开不适的双眼，而这一看，顿时将他们惊得险些魂飞魄散。
只见，在一群人的眼前，分别躺着五具冰冷的尸体，其中包括秦飞远这边的两名炼体七重，一名炼体八重，以及秦五那方的两名炼体八重。
全部身首异处，血溅当场！
“这，这是怎么回事？”
所有人都懵了，秦五身后那位炼体八重的西府弟子更是吓得瘫倒在地，冷汗连连，刚才他若是再快上一步，恐怕也成为那几具尸体中的一员。

就在众人不明所以时，一道好听，但却充满高傲与冰冷的声音缓缓响起。
“我渴望有价值的对手，你们，太弱了……”
（第二位英雄出来了，大家能猜到是谁不？嘎嘎……求
content_en:
Chapter 15 Advancement, Summoning!
In fact, the two of them had long guessed that Qin Xuan gradually regained his strength after possessing the 'Divine Heroes', and his meridians were also healing. But now, not only his strength has stagnated, but even the repair of his meridians has stopped.
Thinking of the fact that the 'Heroes Divine Code' is so eager to obtain the important treasure Lihuo Bell, although it cannot avoid the suspicion of some selfishness, it may also be related to whether Qin Xuan can break through.
However, it cannot be determined yet.
The purpose of Qin Feiyuan and others has been very clear, which is to seize the important treasure Lihuo Bell. For this, Qin Xuan will naturally not send the Lihuo Bell away without thinking.
Not to mention that the Lihuo Bell was already in his pocket, the word 'heavy treasure' alone would not make him give up, but with his current strength, he could not fight or escape, nor could he escape.
In this case, instead of taking advantage of the people in front of you, it is better to work hard and refine it into the 'Hero Divine Code', maybe it will have a certain effect, which will also be of some benefit to yourself.
Of course, this does not mean that Qin Xuan is the first to bow to the mysterious soul in the 'Divine Heroes'.
"No, I can't take the initiative to communicate with it." Galen's voice sounded a little impatient.
The corner of his mouth curled up slightly, and Qin Xuan's eyes flashed with teasing. It seemed that this guy had quite a temper.
Ignoring the surprised expressions of everyone present, Qin Xuan's face suddenly became solemn and he shouted coldly, "I know you can hear me. I admit that you are more arrogant than I thought."
"But don't forget, if I die today, what will happen to you!"
"Also, my patience has its limits. Don't use my patience as capital for your arrogance."
As soon as he finished speaking, in addition to Qin Xuan himself, both the extremely powerful Qin Feiyuan and Qin Wu and others who were watching eagerly from the side were stunned for a moment, and then their expressions changed wildly. The profound energy in their bodies began to rotate at high speed, and a terrifying air wave condensed around the ten people, suddenly shaking the surrounding trees and causing dust to fly.
Qin Xuan's inexplicable words gave everyone the first reaction: there are strong people around! And he is a strong man that he and others cannot afford to offend!
You must know that both Qin Feiyuan and Qin Wu are at the ninth level of body refining, and Qin Feiyuan has reached the peak of the ninth level. He is only one step away from the Qi Sea Realm. To be able to hide around for so long without being discovered is definitely a strength possessed by strong Qi Sea Realm masters!
Time passed by minute by minute, and as expected, the Qi Sea Realm powerhouse did not appear.
After a few more minutes passed, and after it was confirmed that there was no one else around except himself and others, Qin Feiyuan breathed a sigh of relief and slowly regained his momentum. If there really was a Qi Sea Realm powerhouse following Qin Xuan, not to mention snatching the treasure, the lives of himself and others would also be at stake here.
Qin Wu also breathed a sigh of relief. Even though he had the strength of the ninth level of body refining, when facing a strong Qihai realm, even if there were more than ten or twenty warriors of the ninth level of body refining, it would not be enough for the strong Qihai realm to warm up.
The Qi Sea Realm is an absolute watershed in strength!
As if he felt that he was being tricked, the arrogant Qin Feiyuan's face suddenly turned extremely ugly, turning red and blue, and said in a sinister voice, "Qin Xuan, stop playing tricks and take out the valuable treasure quickly. My master's patience is also limited!"
"Haha... Qin Xuan, why don't we cooperate? As long as you lend me your valuable treasure for three months, Xifu and others will ensure that you leave here safely. How about it?" Qin Wu was not to be outdone. He rolled his eyes slightly and said with a smile, "I guarantee it with the reputation of Xifu."
Glancing at Qin Wu as if he were an idiot, Qin Feiyuan did not speak, but stared closely at the young man in black in front of him, as if he was not worried at all that the young man would agree to this tempting condition.
Rolling his eyes, Qin Xuan would indeed not agree to this 'tempting condition'. Qin Wu and Qin Feiyuan fought.Whether he can save his own life is still a question. Besides, Qin Xuan is not stupid enough to think that he can get it back after 'borrowing it for three months'.
As for the reputation guarantee of Nasi House?
This is even more ridiculous. Who do you think Qin Wu is? Even Qin Jiangwei didn't dare to say such words back then.
"It seems that after Qin Jiangwei was killed by him, Qin Wu really put himself in a higher position."
Sighing secretly in his heart, Qin Xuan was not in a hurry at all, waiting quietly for the decision of the 'Heroes Divine Code'. He had temporarily put himself in a passive position, and had spoken clearly, although there was a hint of threat in his words, and he seemed a bit tough.
But he believed that the soul of the 'Divine Heroes' knew how to seize this opportunity.
An opportunity to temporarily suppress Qin Xuan, the master!
Yes, it's just for the time being. Although Qin Xuan doesn't know where the soul of the 'Divine Heroes' is, he will never let it weigh on his head!
Absolutely not!
Suddenly, when Qin Xuan was deep in thought, the 'Hero Divine Code' that stayed in his dantian moved slightly, as if a huge machine had shifted its gears, but Qin Xuan still felt it clearly.
"Master, it allows you to release your ownership of the Lihuo Bell."
Galen's voice sounded at the right time.
Nodding, the 'Divine Code of Heroes' has made a decision, Qin Xuan stopped talking nonsense, and with a move in his heart, under the eyes of everyone in Qin Feiyuan, he quietly terminated the connection with the Chongbao Lihuo Bell.
As soon as the recognition of the master was lifted, before Li Huo Zhong could escape from the body, the 'Hero Divine Code' immediately separated thousands of red threads and wrapped them around Li Huo Zhong. The red threads were like a ball of fiery red flames. Then, the first page opened automatically, and Li Huo Zhong was instantly pulled in.
Pain, after Li Huo Zhong was included in the 'Divine Code of Heroes', endless pain suddenly surged up like a tide.
But if you come to Qin Xuan's Dantian, it is not difficult to find that there are balls of flames burning in his blood, burning his bones, his limbs, and his internal organs!
At this moment, Qin Xuan wanted to scream out the pain in his body, but he could not show discomfort in front of Qin Feiyuan and others, otherwise it would arouse suspicion and all the efforts would be wasted.
With his head lowered, his face was extremely red from holding back, and his teeth were clenched, Qin Xuan felt the pain, just like thousands of ants gnawing at your bone marrow, itchy and painful.
Finally, Qin Feiyuan in the distance seemed to have lost his patience. In his opinion, facing him, the boy in black was simply struggling to his death, with no way to escape. His men could easily subdue him without even taking action himself. The reason why he followed him here in person was because of his elder brother's arrangement, just in case.
Sixth level of body refining? It was just a joke. The kid who was able to kill Qin Jiangwei that day was just lucky.
Yes, in the eyes of Qin Feiyuan, and even in the eyes of the entire younger generation of the Qin family, it was just luck that Qin Xuan could defeat or even kill Qin Jiangwei.
He glanced at the two Nanfu disciples who were at the seventh level of body refining next to them. The two people immediately understood. A sinister smile appeared on the corners of their mouths. The profound energy in their bodies spurted out, and a strong aura swept towards the young man in black who lowered his head. Then, with a whoosh, the two of them flew towards the young man at the same time, with one hand forming a claw and pressing towards the young man's vitals.
Qin Wu, who was always paying attention to the changes in the field, saw the people from Nanfu taking action. His face changed slightly and he nodded. The two Xifu disciples who were at the eighth level of body refining immediately rushed out. Their speed was much faster than the two Nanfu disciples who were at the seventh level of body refining. Their momentum was also much stronger.
The Nan Mansion did not show any signs of weakness. Another disciple of the eighth level of body refining rushed out, but his target was the disciple of the same eighth level of body refining from the west manor. Apparently, his mission was to stop him.
As if unaware of everything, Qin Xuan always lowered his head, as ifAs if he had given up the chance to struggle, there was another sneer in Qin Feiyuan's eyes.
Waste is waste after all.
Boom boom boom.
At this time, a sudden change occurred, and a powerful aura overflowed from the young man in black without any warning, and his profound energy continued to rise and rise again...
The wind rose violently, uprooting some small trees around, and the strong breath made everyone present's breathing stagnate.
Horrible, depressing!
Before anyone could react, a dazzling red light suddenly appeared in the open space, and even the scorching sun in the sky dimmed a little, as if the whole world had turned red. Then, a terrifying and cold sword intent descended out of thin air, as if it were reigning over the world, making people fearful and frightened.
Before the dazzling light receded, the sword light suddenly appeared, replacing the scorching sun in the sky. It was dazzling, and the sharp and endless killing intent filled the whole place, as if this sword was only born for killing.
The sword light came and went quickly. When the sword light dissipated, Qin Feiyuan and others opened their uncomfortable eyes, and this sight shocked them to the point of almost losing their souls.
I saw five cold corpses lying in front of a group of people, including two seventh-level body refiners on Qin Feiyuan's side, one eighth-level body refiner, and two eighth-level body refiners on Qin Wu's side.
All of them had their heads missing, and their blood was splattered on the spot!
"What, what's going on?"
Everyone was stunned. The eighth-level Xifu disciple behind Qin Wu was so frightened that he collapsed to the ground, sweating profusely. If he had taken one step faster just now, he might have become one of those corpses.
Just when everyone was confused, a pleasant but arrogant and cold voice slowly sounded out.
"I long for worthy opponents, you are too weak..."
(The second hero has come out. Can anyone guess who it is? Gaga...please
